decisive_spans.text: Contrast-enhanced thoracic magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated an inflammatory lesion of the T9 lamina and a posterior epidural abscess compressing the spinal cord at T9–T10

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states the presence of a posterior epidural abscess compressing the spinal cord, which is the defining characteristic of a spinal epidural abscess. While other diagnoses like vertebral osteomyelitis are supported, the direct imaging finding of an epidural abscess makes D5 the most specific and likely diagnosis.
